title.narrative: Activity under preparation Cooperation Facility for the Philippines

description.narrative: The Action aims to fund a Cooperation Facility for the Philippines for the period 2025-2027, providing the European Commission with the possibility to finance small-scale activities that are needed for the achievement of the objectives of the Neighbourhood, Development and International Cooperation Instrument (NDICI-Global Europe), as articulated in the country¿s MIP priority areas 1) Green, Resilient Economy and Green Jobs, and 2) Peaceful and Just Society, Good Governance. Through the Cooperation Facility, the EU Delegation will enhance the efficiency, performance, and impact of EU policy dialogues and operations related to MIP priorities, as well as the implementation of the Global Gateway Strategy and the adoption of the Global Gateway 360 degree approach. The Cooperation Facility will also support the EU in the programming of the Annual Action Plans 2026-2027. It will further promote the Team Europe approach, including in the engagement with private sector, government, civil society, youth, and academia. Overall, the Cooperation Facility will provide the EU with the flexibility to mobilise expertise and resources to rapidly address policy reform needs emerging from the policy dialogue with strategic partners and stakeholders. Under the country-based Cooperation Facility, support is also foreseen for Strategic Communication activities with the aim to raise public awareness, understanding and engagement with the EU in the Philippines, on MIP priorities, the Global Gateway strategy and Team Europe approach. The Action is aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and particularly SDG 17 (Partnership for the Goals).
